record.description_evidence:
“SView看图纸”是一款面向机械制造、建筑施工行业，快速浏览二/三维CAD轻量化图纸软件。“SView看图纸”支持手机APP/平板端、网页端、电脑端、小程序多端同步存储、浏览，提供近50种主流二维/三维CAD格式，解决不同行业、不同岗位快速看图需求。“SView看图纸”正利用AI大模型，逐步转型升级为赋能机械制造、建筑工程、工业设计等行业用户的“国产工业软件SaaS开放平台”，通过AI技术推动制造全行业效能革命。
【主要功能】
1、兼容近50种CAD图纸
“SView看图纸”支持打开SolidWorks、Navisworks（.nwc、.nwd）、PROE/CREO、UG/NX、CATIA、Inventor、.stp、DWG、DXF、.fbx、.3ds、.3dm等近50余种主流二/三维CAD文件格式，兼容所有版本，有效解决设计软件兼容格式单一、低版本软件无法兼容高版本软件图纸的情况。

2、同CAD一样专业的测量功能
[智能测量] 系统可自动判定测量类别，并快速计算得出结果。
[距离测量] 支持点-点、点-点、点-面、线-线、线-面、面-面距离测量。并支持点-点/点-线/线-线 线性测量，获得该线段在X/Y/Z轴的分解投影距离。
[角度测量] 支持线-线、线-面、面-面间进行角度测量。
[半/直径] 支持测量圆的半径、直径数据。
[孔/轴距] 支持测量不同孔、轴之间的直线距离。
[壁厚] 一键获取管道壁厚，掌握管道强度。
[点坐标] 快速获取模型上某点在坐标系中的坐标。
[线长] 支持测量线段或曲线的长度，平面或曲面的周长。
[面积] 支持测量某单个零件面积、模型总表面积。
[体积] 支持测量单个零件或模型总体积。
[体积重量] 一键测算模型体积重量。根据型材密度设定价格，快速计算报价。

3、业内首发AI渲染功能
“SView看图纸”业内首发AI渲染功能，将人工智能技术与三维可视化深度结合，自动根据结构特征，匹配金属、塑料、玻璃等基础材质，带来更高效、更真实的模型质感呈现体验。无需复杂操作，让设计意图精准转化为视觉语言。

4、免费看二维图纸，不含广告
“SView看图纸”支持DWG/DXF/.slddrw/.prt/.CATDrawing二维图纸无广告免费浏览！“SView看图纸”能够打开装配图、零件图、原理图等全类别图纸，随时查阅图层布局、技术说明。可对组装配合要求、零件关键公差进行批注，还可针对未注明尺寸进行数据测量，为用户带来二维看图同样专业的优秀体验。
二维图纸支持[长度测量]、[角度测量]、[半径测量]、[直径测量]。

5、提供专业的三维看图体验
“SView看图纸”精准转换PMI（产品制造信息），提供指定/整体剖视、分级爆炸的全三维浏览方式，能够实现基于三维图纸的批注、图纸加密分享、灯光调节、材质渲染、装配树编辑等功能，为全行业用户提供同CAD一样的专业看图体验。

6、行业交流与资源共享
“SView看图纸”内设19+ 行业社群，涵盖了多个行业、地区，是人脉资源、产业链资源、专业知识交流地。可即时交流，搭建上下游产业即时交流平台，促进了信息和技术的快速流通，有助于加强合作伙伴之间的联系。

客服电话：166-5200-6557/166-5200-6556。

record.description_evidence:
大厨日历：你的 AI 饮食管家

每天为“今天吃什么”“冰箱里还有什么”“买菜太麻烦”而烦恼？ 
大厨日历用 AI 帮你管理菜谱、冰箱、饮食计划和购物清单，一站式搞定每天的饮食。

# 核心功能
【大厨AI】
不知道吃什么？直接问它。大厨AI是你专属的饮食管家:

· 一句话推荐菜谱，还能帮你排进饮食计划
· 拍张照，食材自动录入冰箱库存
· 根据库存，告诉你现在能做什么菜
· 发张菜谱截图给它，自动整理保存进你的菜谱

它不只是回答问题，还能直接帮你管理菜谱、库存、饮食计划和购物清单。

【冰箱管理】
拍张照就能录入食材，库存随时查看。智能提醒即将过期的食材，优先帮你消耗库存。

【饮食计划】
告诉 AI 你的喜好，它就能帮你安排每天的饮食，不再为每天吃什么发愁。日历视图一目了然，每天吃什么、买什么，提前安排得明明白白。

【智能购物清单】
结合饮食计划和冰箱库存，自动生成购物清单，买什么、买多少清清楚楚，减少漏买和重复购买。支持灵动岛和实时活动，购物时照着买，无需来回切换 App。

【菜谱管家】
菜谱截图、文字、视频发给 AI，自动整理保存；也可以让 AI 根据你的需求生成菜谱。菜谱广场汇集全球 2000+ 道菜谱，从快手菜、家常菜到节日宴客菜，都能找到灵感。

【营养统计】
每道菜谱自动分析热量、蛋白质、碳水和脂肪，搭配饮食计划，每天吃了多少、营养是否均衡，一目了然。还支持按人数分摊计算热量。

# 自动续费订阅说明
1.订阅服务：
   a). Pro 会员连续包月（1 个月）、Pro 会员连续包年（12 个月）
2. 自动续费：购买自动续费订阅的帐号，会在每个扣费周期到期前 24 小时，自动在 Apple 账户扣费并延长会员有效期。
3. 关闭服务：如需取消订阅，请手动打开 iOS 的“设置”，进入“Apple 账户”，点击“订阅”，选择”大厨日历“取消订阅即可。如未在订阅期结束的至少 24 小时前关闭订阅，此订阅将会自动续订。
4. 服务协议：
   a). 大厨日历服务协议（含自动订阅服务规则）：https://dachurili.com/zh/terms-of-service
   b). EULA：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
5. 隐私协议：https://dachurili.com/zh/privacy-policy

record.name: Genius, AI travel assistant
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Citizens of NY: use code NY to enter the Genius App and find the best travel packages!

NEW! Genius®, your AI travel advisor!

Genius® is the new travel app that opens up the whole world for you in a few seconds. With this app you can transform any destination into a cheap travel package - including flight and hotel. No idea where you want to go? No problem! Just enter your budget and the app does the rest and surprises you with destinations that you probably haven't thought of yourself! The price shown always includes hotel and flight for the entire period!
You can search for your ideal travel package in 3 different ways:

1) Check out our tips at the top! Here you can find our best offers! Tip: would you rather go on a different date or for example more days? Then click on the trip that appeals to you and then change the dates there. You will then see if the trip is also available and what it would cost.

2) Search yourself? This is of course also possible. Then click on 'Personalize'. You can, among other things, enter the dates you want and the desired destination. Do you not yet know exactly where you want to go or are you looking for inspiration? Simply set your budget and be surprised by the destinations where you can go with your budget on the dates you entered! Genius® is the one-stop-shop for price-conscious travelers.

3) Chat with Genius®, your AI travel advisor. The first in the world to conjure up travel packages for you in no time. Genius asks you a few questions and then starts searching for you and does its best to match this as much as possible to your travel wishes. You can then also expand your search, by going back to the conversation and for example indicating that you only want three-star hotels, etc.

Save money

Discover the world smarter with the help of Genius! Every day we have new travel packages that can be booked at a competitive rate. Will it be Lisbon? Las Vegas? Hawaii? You can decide. And of course you can also search by budget, who will manage to go on holiday the cheapest? Who knows, maybe it will be you!

Last-minute

Is it suddenly going to rain for a long time, is it cold? Time for a last-minute! Click on 'departure within 1 week' at the top for all options to be able to enjoy the sun somewhere in no time!

Dynamic Packaging

Travel package 2.0, that's Dynamic Packaging. Yes, we have managed to find a new way to convert an Expedia Flight and Expedia accommodation at a reduced rate into a tailor-made holiday package. Whether it's a weekend away to your favourite city, a business trip, a sunny holiday on a tropical island or a week of skiing in the mountains - it can all be found at Genius! 

Expedia

You book and pay for your trip with the trusted Expedia, one of the most prominent and well-known travel providers in the world.

Mix & Match

Every booking is tailor-made and you decide for yourself! Scroll through all available flights and choose whether you want the fastest, cheapest or most convenient flight. Not a morning person? No problem. Luxury hotel or a hostel? You are in control.
After selecting, you will see the options for the available flights and you have the freedom to choose the most attractive hotel room. You will immediately see the effect on the price if you adjust the flight or hotel room. You can easily save your favorite options, share them with your travel partners and compare the different options you have found.
What is a travel package? It may sound a bit corny, but it simply means that the price includes hotel and flight. Everything arranged in one go, how nice is that! Of course without hidden costs, because Genius does not like that. What you see is what you get! Be inspired and do not wait any longer, because for the ultra-cheap trips: gone = gone!
Genius® wishes you lots of fun searching and booking!

NoteX: Anotador com IA, Agente de Reuniões com IA, Caderno Inteligente e Voz para Notas

Transcrição ao vivo, agente de reuniões e resumos inteligentes
NoteX é um anotador com IA e um caderno inteligente tudo em um que transforma reuniões, aulas e conversas em notas claras, resumos e apresentações. Desenvolvido para profissionais, estudantes e equipes, o NoteX ajuda você a manter o foco enquanto a IA captura, organiza e transforma informações em conhecimento acionável.

Transcrição ao vivo e reuniões multilíngues
O NoteX oferece transcrição em tempo real com alta precisão para reuniões, aulas e discussões. Ele oferece suporte a reuniões multilíngues, permitindo transcrever e traduzir conversas em vários idiomas, sendo ideal para equipes globais, aulas internacionais e colaboração remota.

Agente de reuniões com IA para reuniões online
Com o agente de reuniões com IA integrado, o NoteX pode entrar automaticamente em reuniões online por meio de um link e registrar tudo para você. Ele é compatível com Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams e WebEx, garantindo que você não perca discussões importantes mesmo quando não puder participar ao vivo.

Sincronização de calendário para anotações automáticas
Conecte seu calendário ao NoteX e deixe que a IA se prepare automaticamente para as próximas reuniões. Notas, transcrições e resumos são gerados e organizados sem configuração manual, criando um fluxo de trabalho contínuo desde o agendamento até o acompanhamento.

Voz para notas e atas de reunião
Grave ou envie áudio e converta instantaneamente a fala em notas estruturadas, atas de reunião, pontos-chave e itens de ação. O NoteX oferece resultados rápidos e confiáveis para que você possa se concentrar na conversa em vez de digitar.

Caderno com IA que conecta seu conhecimento
Todas as suas notas ficam em um único caderno inteligente com IA que conecta informações relacionadas, melhora a busca e ajuda você a redescobrir insights quando precisar. Seu caderno fica mais inteligente à medida que você o utiliza.

Resumos inteligentes, insights visuais e apresentações
O NoteX cria automaticamente resumos concisos e insights visuais a partir das suas notas. Você pode gerar mapas mentais para compreender tópicos complexos e transformar notas instantaneamente em apresentações profissionais e bem organizadas.

Ferramentas de estudo e compartilhamento de conhecimento

• **快速录音** — 录下一段哭声，即时分析可能需求：饿了、困了、不舒服、需要安抚等。

**减轻父母认知负担**
当宝宝持续哭闹时，小宝婴语帮助你减少猜测，更快决定下一步该怎么安抚。

Teamily is the human–agent platform where you and always-on agents get work done together in one unified and context-aware space. Teamily app unifies always-on AI agents, a reinvented AI-native messenger, an office suite, meetings, voice and video calls, workflows, a knowledge base, and business systems in one connected space.


Highlighted features:

1. A full productivity stack to turn conversations into finished work, faster than ever

Not just chat: create and automate. Built-in human-agent collaborative studios supporting batch comments/marks and direct edits with AI together, for web, slides, docs, dashboards, and more turn conversations into deliverables.



2. First-class agents, capable on arrival.  Not bots bolted onto a messenger.

Don't waste time configuring AI agents with limited capabilities bolted onto a messenger. Work with first-class agents built in from day one. They chat, collaborate, and build alongside you across 1:1 conversations (DMs), group conversations, collaborative studios, and the public feed. In seconds, you can even create and customize your own agents or agent teams—as AI twins, companions, or collaborators.



3. One connected context so AI can actually work with complete knowledge

Agents can only work when they share one connected context. Your conversations, relationships, documents, apps, and the open ecosystem all feed into a single living context—so every agent understands the full picture without you ever repeating yourself.


4. Enhanced human-agent collaboration with more connected context to reinvented Office Suite, including AI-native documents (docs, slides, pdfs) and Zoom-like Meeting.



5. Living memory that builds and reorganizes itself from every conversation

Memory isn't a searchable chat history. It's living memory that continuously builds and reorganizes itself from every conversation, learning your knowledge, taste, and relationships



6. Not one static model. The best team of models for every task

A context-aware semantic router orchestrates the best combination of models and agents for every task—matching specialized intelligence to your goals instead of forcing one model to do everything. The result is the best balance of speed, cost, and quality for every task.



7. Self-improving intelligence. The more you use it, the smarter it becomes

Models and skills continuously evolve through real-time human–agent collaboration — the system gets sharper the more you use it.


8. Agent Workspace - The agent operation platform to manage messages received, channels in Slack/WhatsApp/iMessage and more, artifacts, Agent APIs, and more



9. You're never alone. Tap into a network of shared intelligence

The public feed lets you remix ideas, fork proven agents, and build on shared intelligence instead of starting from scratch.


10. Personalized AI & Effortless Human-AI Communication

Your own AI agent with global memory that learns your preferences, knowledge, and context over time. Chat naturally with text, voice, images, and files, with built-in translation and everyday AI tools that make human-AI communication and team collaboration effortless.


Who Is Teamily AI For?

- Everyone who may need AI for personal or team tasks: business owners, co-workers, friends, communities, and family.

- Every company which wants to automate the business operations.

- Professionals who want a personal AI workforce to delegate tasks and amplify output.

- Creators and researchers who need memory-rich, context-aware AI collaborators

- Teams who want AI agents embedded in their daily workflows and group chats.

Kanon AI 是一款以"设备本地端 AI"为核心的隐私翻译与 AI 助理。当你使用本地模型时，所有数据完全不离开你的 iPhone — 没有服务器、没有 API、没有云端记录。


【AI 图片与音乐生成｜完全离线】
• AI 图片生成：文字出图，本地 Stable Diffusion（多模型／风格 LoRA／参考图／自动修脸）。
• AI 音乐生成：文字生成音乐，本地 Stable Audio 3，内建播放器，可存档分享。
• 提示词支援多国语言，自动翻英再生成。

【核心特色】
• 100+ 语言离线翻译，无需网络即可使用
• 50+ 个 Kanon AI 小帮手：翻译润色、文字改写、语法检查、邮件撰写、创意发想、旅游会话等各种场景
• 虚拟陪伴：创建专属 AI 角色，Live2D 动画、语音聊天、跨 session 记忆
• 多种本地 AI 模型依机型 RAM 自动推荐：
  - Kanon Lite（Qwen 2.5 1.5B）— iPhone XS 以上
  - Kanon Light（Gemma 4 E2B）— iPhone 12 以上推荐
  - Kanon Smart（Gemma 4 E4B）— 12 GB RAM 机型（iPhone 17 Pro 系列）
  - Kanon Pro — 高阶机型专属增强版
  - 自定义模型 — 可自行输入 GGUF 模型下载网址
• 云端高品质语音：免费提供 80+ 语系、400+ 个高品质神经语音

【虚拟陪伴】
• 创建专属 AI 角色，自定义名字、性别、年龄、个性、描述
• 10 种个性标签与 8 种回复语言可选
• 4 个免费 Live2D 动画角色（Haru、Hiyori、Mark、Natori）
• 呼吸、眨眼、头部摆动、身体摆动、嘴型同步全部实时渲染
• 语音优先聊天：Push-to-Talk + Apple Speech + 自动 TTS 播放
• 记忆系统：角色会记住你说过的事，跨对话 Session 持续
• 四状态动画：待机 / 聆听中 / 思考中 / 说话中
• 完全离线，对话与记忆 100% 存在本地

【多模态 AI】
• 图片理解：AI Chat 中上传图片，Gemma 4 本地模型直接看懂图片内容
• 语音理解：录制最长 30 秒语音，AI 直接听懂并回复
• 菜单、看板、文件拍照即可翻译+解释，完全离线

【主要功能】
• Hub 首页：整合所有 AI 工具与常用功能的一站式入口，已设定虚拟陪伴时会显示角色动画
• 翻译：输入或粘贴文字，本地或云端任你选
• 字典：详细词义、例句、语法说明、发音标示
• AI Chat：使用本地模型完全免费，支持图片和语音，多轮对话记录自动保存
• 50+ Kanon 小帮手：17 种语言完整支持各类 AI 工具，结果可语音朗读
• 虚拟陪伴：Live2D 动画角色，语音聊天，跨 session 记忆
• 语言家教：自由对话式语言学习，支持多个对话 Session 管理
• 语言教室：互动式学习单词、语法、会话练习
• 笔记本：所有 AI 结果可存入笔记本，支持搜索、重命名、分类浏览
• 即时对话：两人即时跨语言对话，适合面对面交流场景
• 相机翻译：标准 OCR / 云端 AI / 本地 AI 三种模式
• 语音角色自定义：为不同语言指定专属语音角色
• 智能语系判断：三层混合检测，自动检测来源语言并切换翻译方向

【翻译品质强化】
• 翻译品质模式：精准/平衡两档可调，适应不同需求
• 防幻觉机制：每句独立翻译，避免跨句误译
• 即时流式输出：翻译结果逐字显示，无需等待完整结果
• 双向翻译 TTS 自动检测结果语言并使用对应语音

【隐私保护】
• 本地模型完全离线运行，信息永远不离开你的 iPhone
• 虚拟陪伴所有对话与记忆 100% 存在本地 SQLite
• 模型下载文件排除 iCloud 备份

【版本说明】
• 部分进阶模型与云端 AI 需购买解锁或订阅方案
• 订阅可随时于系统设置中取消
• 免费版本即可使用核心翻译与基础 AI 功能

【支持语言】
• 17 种语言完整支持 AI 工具
• 100+ 语言翻译
• 云端语音支持 80+ 语系、400+ 神经语音
• 9 种界面语言：繁中、简中、港繁、英、日、韩、法、泰、越

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Mem is your personal AI agent—a chief of staff that builds a living picture of your tasks, projects, and goals, then helps you follow through. Capture notes, meetings, ideas, research, and links without stopping to organize. Mem Agent uses that context to answer questions, recall details, plan, draft, summarize, and move work forward.

YOUR WORKSPACE, KEPT FOR YOU
Write it down, say it out loud, record a meeting, or save it from another app. Mem keeps everything connected, searchable, and ready when you need it.

ASK ANYTIME. SKIP THE BRIEFING.
Mem Agent knows the context you have saved, so you can ask what matters now instead of rebuilding the backstory. Recall a detail, summarize a week of meetings, connect related ideas, draft a message, or plan the next step.

PROACTIVE WORK THAT SCALES
Mem automatically detects and tracks tasks and projects from the notes you create or edit. With Mem Pro, add custom routines that prepare briefings, do research, organize notes, and send scheduled reminders. Connect tools like Gmail, Slack, and Todoist so Mem can use more of your work as context.

VOICE NOTES THAT STAY USEFUL
Record a thought, meeting, or reminder. Mem keeps the audio and transcript together and helps turn rough input into clear, structured notes.

FIND ANYTHING YOU’VE SAVED
Search by topic, person, project, or a vague memory. Mem helps retrieve information even when you do not remember the exact wording.

CAPTURE FROM ANYWHERE
Use Share to Mem to save text, links, webpages, files, and more from other apps. Capture quickly, then return to the work in front of you.

AVAILABLE ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
Use Mem on iPhone, Mac, Windows, and the web. Work offline on iPhone, then sync when you are connected again.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your notes start private. Share them only when you choose.

Every plan includes Mem Agent; usage limits vary by plan. Custom routines and connections require Mem Pro or higher. Trial eligibility and pricing are shown in the app.
